subject: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90min technical deep dive & draft agenda
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90min technical deep dive & draft agenda

Hi Sara / Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear more about the latency-sensitive inference workloads you're planning (edge + burst on cloud). To keep momentum, we'd like to schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML infra and ops leads to:

- Walk through your current inference topology and traffic profiles
- Validate latency/throughput SLOs and model size/sequence constraints
- Discuss integration approach (hosted API vs dedicated vs private) and data handling controls
- Surface any compliance/audit needs up front

Proposed structure (we can tweak):
1) 10 min quick recap + goals
2) 30–40 min architecture walk / perf targets
3) 15–25 min integration & deployment options (routing, caching, quantization)
4) 10–15 min open questions & next steps

We typically aim for 75 minutes for this type of session. Can you share 2–3 75-min windows over the next two weeks? Time zone note: I'm in PDT (UTC-7).

Attached: discovery notes and a one-page draft agenda for the session.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: novapulse-discovery-notes.pdf (1.2MB, PDF) — discovery call highlights; proposed-tdx-agenda.md (text) — session outline
